summary.text: Justin Bamberg is a Democratic state representative who has represented South Carolina House District 90 since 2015 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney with Bamberg Legal, LLC, he serves on the House Judiciary Committee and, according to Ballotpedia, is the only candidate listed in the general election for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Justin Bamberg was born on March 7, 1987, and earned a B.A. in 2009 and a J.D. in 2011, both from the University of South Carolina, according to the House member page.

The page lists him as a member of the South Carolina Bar Association and its Young Lawyers Division, a board member of Healing Species, Inc. since 2009 and chairman of that board in 2014, and third vice chairman of the Bamberg County Democratic Party.
Bamberg has served in the South Carolina House of Representatives since 2015.
Ballotpedia reports that he defeated Dan Lawrence in the 2016 election for the seat, and that the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary was canceled.
